title: Carly's dashboard: one list + Today pass
question: Your steer: one list with filter chips, and a black pass on top showing who is on today. Three ways to do it. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Compact Pass Band
options.lineage: One List + Filters, with today as a slim black band
options.thesis: Today is one slim black band with each person as a chip, so the list starts almost at the top; Hours waits at the end as one row.
options.viewport: Greeting with '7 things need you'; black band 'Today: ● Josh · Night · 43 min  ✓ Ana · Morning'; chips All 7 · Requests 2 · Flags 4 · Supplies 1 (stay pinned when scrolling); full-read rows with inline Approve; Fortnight hours as one row that opens a sheet.
options.risk: With 3+ shifts a day the band wraps to two lines.

options.label: Pass with Summary Footer
options.lineage: One List + Filters, with a full Today pass that also carries the counts
options.thesis: A full Today pass (one row per person) whose footer says '7 things need you' and links Hours; the chips and list follow straight under it.
options.viewport: Greeting; black pass: Ana · Morning ✓ Done, Josh · Night ● On shift, footer '7 things need you · Hours 16h 44m ›'; chips; full-read list.
options.risk: The pass is taller, so the first request sits lower on small phones.

options.label: Pass + List by Day
options.lineage: One List + Filters, with quiet day labels inside the list
options.thesis: Full Today pass, chips, then one list split by quiet labels 'Today' and 'Earlier this week', so fresh items read first.
options.viewport: Greeting; full Today pass; chips; 'Today' label with the swap, Josh's extra time and Ana's flag; 'Earlier this week' with older flags; Hours row at the end.
options.risk: Day labels add a little height; old flags may feel less urgent.
